poster_title: CODE2VIDEO: A CODE-CENTRIC PARADIGM FOR EDUCATIONAL VIDEO GENERATION
authors: Yanzhe Chen, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
paper_info: Show Lab, National University of Singapore, 2023

content: Recent generative models struggle with professional educational video synthesis.
Educational videos require deep domain expertise and step-by-step reasoning.
Multi-agent pipelines show promise in complex video generation tasks.
panels.headline: Executable Python code as the unifying medium for generating educational videos.

content: Challenges in creating high-quality educational videos that are both coherent and clear.
Evaluating educational videos beyond appearance to ensure effectiveness and alignment.
panels.headline: Maintaining temporal coherence and spatial clarity in educational videos.

content: Code2Video uses executable Python code for generating educational videos.
Planner structures content into coherent flows and prepares visual assets.
Coder translates instructions into Manim code for precise visualizations.
Critic refines spatial layout and clarity using visual anchor prompts.
panels.figure_caption: Overview of Code2Video: A code-centric paradigm for educational video generation, where Planner ensures temporal flow, Coder bridges instructions to executable animations, and Critic refines spatial layout.
panels.headline: Code2Video framework with Planner, Coder, and Critic agents.

content: MMMC benchmark consists of 13 subject categories with exemplar learning topics.
Evaluation metrics include VLM-as-a-Judge aesthetic scores, code efficiency, and TeachQuiz for knowledge transfer.
panels.figure_caption: Comprehensive overview of the MMMC dataset, including subject category distribution, a word cloud of learning topics, and average topic length per category.
panels.headline: MMMC benchmark with 13 subject categories and multi-dimensional metrics.

content: Code2Video outperforms human-crafted tutorials in TeachQuiz scores.
Generated videos are comparable to professional tutorials in human studies.
panels.figure_caption: Score gap between Learning-from-Video and Unlearning stages in the TeachQuiz evaluation.
panels.headline: 40% improvement in TeachQuiz scores over direct code generation.

content: Code2Video offers a new paradigm for educational video generation.
The MMMC benchmark provides a comprehensive evaluation framework.
The approach relies on Manim, which may not be suitable for all content.
Effectiveness may vary across subject domains and learning styles.
panels.headline: Scalable, interpretable, and controllable approach to generating educational videos.
